svg.title: Ask your AI about collected messages
svg.desc: Synthetic example: two collected messages move a Friday meetup from 7 PM to 7:30 PM at the same café. The user asks their connected AI what changed, and it answers from those messages.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
